theorem QOU.Mathlib.sum_numSYT_recurrence' (n : ℕ) :
∑ μ : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n + 2 }, numStandardYoungTableaux ↑μ = ∑ μ : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n + 1 }, numStandardYoungTableaux ↑μ + (n + 1) * ∑ μ : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n }, numStandardYoungTableaux ↑μ

theorem QOU.Mathlib.sum_numSYT_recurrence (h : UpOperatorIdentity) (n : ℕ) :
∑ μ : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n + 2 }, numStandardYoungTableaux ↑μ = ∑ μ : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n + 1 }, numStandardYoungTableaux ↑μ + (n + 1) * ∑ μ : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n }, numStandardYoungTableaux ↑μ

theorem QOU.Mathlib.sum_numSYT_mul_corners_of_upOperator (h : UpOperatorIdentity) (n : ℕ) :
∑ ν : { ν : YoungDiagram // ν.cells.card = n + 1 }, numStandardYoungTableaux ↑ν * Fintype.card { c : ℕ × ℕ // IsCornerCell (↑ν) c } = (n + 1) * ∑ μ : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n }, numStandardYoungTableaux ↑μ

theorem QOU.Mathlib.upOperatorIdentity_holds :
UpOperatorIdentity

theorem QOU.Mathlib.sum_subtype_addable_eq_upSum (μ : YoungDiagram) :
∑ s : { s : ℕ × ℕ // IsAddableCell μ s }, numStandardYoungTableaux (addCell μ ↑s ⋯) = upSum μ

def QOU.Mathlib.UpOperatorIdentity :
Prop

theorem QOU.Mathlib.sum_numSYT_succ_split (n : ℕ) :
∑ μ : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n + 1 }, numStandardYoungTableaux ↑μ = ∑ ν : { ν : YoungDiagram // ν.cells.card = n }, numStandardYoungTableaux ↑ν + ∑ ν : { ν : YoungDiagram // ν.cells.card = n }, numStandardYoungTableaux ↑ν * (cornerCells ↑ν).card

theorem QOU.Mathlib.sum_numSYT_succ (n : ℕ) :
∑ μ : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n + 1 }, numStandardYoungTableaux ↑μ = ∑ ν : { ν : YoungDiagram // ν.cells.card = n }, numStandardYoungTableaux ↑ν * Fintype.card { s : ℕ × ℕ // IsAddableCell (↑ν) s }

theorem QOU.Mathlib.rankExchange_fst_fst (n : ℕ) (x : (μ : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n + 1 }) × { c : ℕ × ℕ // IsCornerCell (↑μ) c }) :
↑((rankExchange n) x).fst = eraseCorner ↑x.fst ↑x.snd ⋯

def QOU.Mathlib.rankExchange (n : ℕ) :
(μ : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n + 1 }) × { c : ℕ × ℕ // IsCornerCell (↑μ) c } ≃ (ν : { ν : YoungDiagram // ν.cells.card = n }) × { s : ℕ × ℕ // IsAddableCell (↑ν) s }

def QOU.Mathlib.sizedAddPairSigma' (n : ℕ) :
SizedAddPair n ≃ (ν : { ν : YoungDiagram // ν.cells.card = n }) × { s : ℕ × ℕ // IsAddableCell (↑ν) s }

def QOU.Mathlib.sizedCornerPairSigma' (n : ℕ) :
SizedCornerPair n ≃ (μ : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n + 1 }) × { c : ℕ × ℕ // IsCornerCell (↑μ) c }

instance QOU.Mathlib.fintypeAddableSubtype (ν : YoungDiagram) :
Fintype { s : ℕ × ℕ // IsAddableCell ν s }

theorem QOU.Mathlib.sum_cornerCells_succ (n : ℕ) :
∑ μ : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n + 1 }, (cornerCells ↑μ).card = ∑ ν : { ν : YoungDiagram // ν.cells.card = n }, (cornerCells ↑ν).card + Fintype.card { ν : YoungDiagram // ν.cells.card = n }

theorem QOU.Mathlib.sum_cornerCells_succ_eq_sum_addableCells (n : ℕ) :
∑ μ : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n + 1 }, (cornerCells ↑μ).card = ∑ ν : { ν : YoungDiagram // ν.cells.card = n }, (addableCells ↑ν).card

def QOU.Mathlib.sizedAddPairSigma (n : ℕ) :
SizedAddPair n ≃ (ν : { ν : YoungDiagram // ν.cells.card = n }) × { s : ℕ × ℕ // s ∈ addableCells ↑ν }

def QOU.Mathlib.sizedCornerPairSigma (n : ℕ) :
SizedCornerPair n ≃ (μ : { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n + 1 }) × { c : ℕ × ℕ // c ∈ cornerCells ↑μ }

noncomputable instance QOU.Mathlib.fintypeSizedDiagram (n : ℕ) :
Fintype { μ : YoungDiagram // μ.cells.card = n }
